499.title: Number box: tap anywhere on it to edit the whole number
humanItems: Phone width: tap the ₪ sign of the price per guest in the pricing meter → the whole number is selected; typing replaces it. Same on the % suffix of waste in the product form.
Recipe builder: tap the unit label next to an ingredient quantity → the number is selected; pressing Enter still moves to the next row.
The two `[human]` items under Success Criteria pass.

500.title: One stepper (+/−) for every number: same hold-to-repeat, steps and minimum
humanItems: Recipe builder ingredient quantity, cook-view amount and menu guest count: hold − → repeats at the same speed in all three and stops at the minimum.
Phone width: press and hold + on the guest count → it repeats; release stops it.
The cook-view and menu-intelligence steppers still look like their own pages (the ink and paper skins).
The three `[human]` items under Success Criteria pass.

501.title: Delete versus undo: entity deletes keep the popup, line removals get an undo toast
humanItems: Product form: delete a purchase option → it disappears at once, a toast with "undo" shows → pressing undo brings it back in the same place.
Event notes: delete a note → toast with "undo" → undo brings the note back and it is still there after a reload.
Delete a supplier → the confirm popup (unchanged).
The three `[human]` items under Success Criteria pass.

D1 behaviour: a tap on the box while the number is already focused does nothing extra, and a disabled, read-only or locked number is not focused (as the readiness answers say) — reverse: remove the activeElement and disabled checks in number-box.directive.ts targetInput_()
D2 behaviour: the directive ignores presses on buttons, anchors, selects, textareas, other inputs and .c-chip inside the box — reverse: shrink the INTERACTIVE selector in number-box.directive.ts
D3 behaviour: the directive also cancels mousedown (not only pointerdown) when it focuses the number, so the browser does not move focus away again — reverse: remove the (mousedown) host binding

D4 behaviour: the reuse-lint rule is line-based — it warns on any added type='number' line in a src/app html that has no appNumberBox on the same line; a new input inside an existing box also warns — reverse: delete the number-input-outside-number-box entry in registry-families.mjs
